actions.medicalBoardHint: RDF uses the board fitness decision at this stage.
actions.medicalCertificateHint: RNP and RCS use the certificate verdict. A verified certificate requires the reviewing physician's name.
actions.finalHint: Record the human final shortlist decision.
actions.acceptHint: Acceptance is the final state transition and may trigger cross-agency auto-withdrawal.
actions.adjudicationHint: This record is held for human review. Clear returns it to the autonomous lane; reject terminates it.
actions.confirmAcceptBody: Kwakira bishyira iyi dosiye kuri ACCEPTED kandi bishobora gukura izindi dosiye z’uwasabye mu nzira. Komeza gusa nyuma yo kurangiza isuzuma.
actions.confirmShortlistBody: Ibi byandika umwanzuro wa nyuma SHORTLIST. Komeza gusa nyuma y’isuzuma risabwa.
actions.confirmRejectBody: Ibi byandika umwanzuro REJECTED. Komeza gusa igihe ibyemezo byasuzumwe.
actions.confirmClearBody: Ibi bikuraho hold y’isuzuma kandi dosiye igasubira mu murongo w’ikora ryikora. Komeza gusa hold imaze gukemurwa.
